'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Kazakh protests]]
**The death toll from the civil unrest in [[Kazakhstan]] increases to 225, including 19 members of the security forces, according to a statement from the [[Prosecutor General's Office of Kazakhstan|Prosecutor General's Office]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kazakhstan-says-225-bodies-delivered-morgues-during-unrest-2022-01-15/ (Reuters)]

*[[Colleyville synagogue hostage crisis]]
**An armed man claiming to be the brother of Pakistani [[Al-Qaeda]] suspect [[Aafia Siddiqui]] holds congregants hostage at Congregation Beth Israel [[Synagogue]] in [[Colleyville, Texas]], United States. He is later shot and killed by police. [https://www.star-telegram.com/news/local/crime/article257360862.html (''Fort Worth Star-Telegram'')] [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-692626 (''Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Hunga Tonga eruption and tsunami]]
**[[Tonga]] is hit by ashfall and a [[tsunami]] after the eruption of [[Hunga Tonga]], destroying homes as locals struggle to find higher ground. Major flooding is reported in the capital [[Nukuʻalofa]]. [[Shock wave]]s from the eruption are detected as far away as [[Alaska]], [[United States]]. Other [[Pacific Ocean|Pacific]] countries have also advised their citizens to seek higher ground. Internet access has reportedly been disrupted in Tonga. [https://www.smh.com.au/world/oceania/footage-shows-waves-crashing-into-homes-as-tsunami-warning-sounds-in-tonga-20220115-p59ohh.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jan/15/tsunami-warnings-south-pacific-us-california-hawaii-alaska (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.voanews.com/a/tonga-volcanic-eruption-felt-around-the-world-/6398818.html (VOA)]
**[[List of monarchs of Tonga|King]] [[Tupou VI]] is evacuated from the [[Royal Palace, Tonga|Royal Palace]] by [[His Majesty's Armed Forces (Tonga)|His Majesty's Armed Forces]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/01/15/asia/tsunami-warning-tonga-volcano-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
**Two people are killed by a small tsunami in [[Lambayeque, Peru|Lambayeque]], [[Peru]]. [https://www.biobiochile.cl/noticias/internacional/america-latina/2022/01/15/reportan-dos-muertes-y-danos-por-tsunami-en-peru-pais-no-emitio-alerta.shtml (Bio-Bio Chile)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports its first three confirmed deaths related to the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in people from the cities of [[Tabriz]], [[Yazd]] and [[Shahrekord]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/iran-reports-its-first-three-deaths-omicron-covid-19-variant-2438546 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 39,004 new cases of [[COVID-19]], thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 3,168,379. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/philippines-records-all-time-high-covid-19-cases-january-15-2022/ (''Rappler'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in France]]
***[[France]] restricts the validity of [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|health pass]] for fully vaccinated people to seven months after received their second dose and require them to receive [[booster dose]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/coronavirus-digest-new-french-booster-rules-disqualify-previously-vaccinated/a-60434039 (Deutsche Welle)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2022 Serbian constitutional referendum]], [[Kosovo–Serbia relations]]
**In an [[extraordinary session]], the [[Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo]] votes to ban [[Kosovo Serbs]] from voting in [[Serbia]]'s upcoming constitutional referendum on Kosovan territory. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kosovo-bans-serbian-vote-constitutional-changes-its-soil-2022-01-15/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021 NFL season]]
**[[2021–22 NFL playoffs]]
***In [[American football]], the [[2021 Cincinnati Bengals season|Cincinnati Bengals]] defeat the [[2021 Las Vegas Raiders season|Las Vegas Raiders]], 26-19, ending their 31-year playoff drought and winning a playoff game for the first time [[1990 Cincinnati Bengals season|since 1991]].
